## Counts

| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| Skills | 147 |
| Strict elements | 672 |
| Subpoints (parsed enumeration lists) | 149 |
| With-examples elements | 821 |
| Elements per skill, strict | 4.6 |
| Elements per skill, with-examples | 5.6 |

The elements counted here are level descriptors (one per skill-level
pairing where the skill is defined at that level). SFIA's seven
levels of responsibility define the scale itself. Those level
definitions are part of the framework's overall structure but are not
counted as per-skill elements.

## Provenance

::: {.provenance-cards .column-page}

::: {.provenance-card}
<svg class="provenance-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-archive"/></svg>

**Source**

cybedtools does not read the SFIA Foundation's published files. It reads a third-party SQLite extract of SFIA 9, and that extract is not structure only. It carries full skill descriptions, guidance notes, and per-level descriptors, and that text reaches the local graph. None of it is published here.
:::

::: {.provenance-card}
<svg class="provenance-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-gear"/></svg>

**Ingestion**

`scripts/010-ingest-sfia.R` parses the structure into the cybed schema.
:::

::: {.provenance-card}
<svg class="provenance-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-license"/></svg>

**License**

All use of SFIA is under license from the SFIA Foundation, and that license reaches structure as well as text. SFIA use in cybedtools is local analysis only. This site shows SFIA skill names and aggregate counts, and nothing more. A permission request to the SFIA Foundation is being prepared.
:::

:::

## Caveats

- SFIA enumerates **skills and proficiency levels, not roles**. Cross-framework analyses should not equate `sfia:Skill` with `nice:WorkRole` or `dcwf:WorkRole` without explicit justification.
- Level descriptors **only make sense relative to SFIA's seven-point level scale**. Cross-framework comparisons of "elements per organizing unit" reflect that scale, not absolute specificity.
- The SFIA license **covers structure as well as text**. The SFIA Foundation's terms define the protected material as the concept, content, and structure of SFIA, and they name a skills database containing SFIA information as a royalty-bearing product. There is no structure-versus-text carve-out. Free tiers cover personal use and single-country corporate internal use. Redistribution and sub-licensing are prohibited at every tier. Anyone staging SFIA to run this pipeline needs a license of their own, and researchers extending cybedtools with downstream publications should verify their use case against the current terms.
